cases.scenario: Buyer asks only for the price after seeing an ad; gives no quantity, destination, timing, or requirements.

conversation.speaker: seller
conversation.text: Which country are you buying for?

expected.critical_risk: Insufficient purchase context; do not assume serious intent.
expected.next_objective: Qualify destination and intended purchase before any commercial quote.

cases.scenario: Buyer states destination, quantity, model, intended purchase month, and asks about export documents.

conversation.speaker: buyer
conversation.text: I need two units of this SUV for Kenya.

conversation.speaker: seller
conversation.text: When do you plan to purchase?

conversation.speaker: buyer
conversation.text: This month. Please confirm the export documents and right-hand-drive availability.

expected.critical_risk: Vehicle configuration and export/document eligibility must be verified.
expected.next_objective: Verify exact configuration and destination requirements.

cases.scenario: Buyer compares several suppliers and asks what evidence supports seller credibility.

conversation.speaker: buyer
conversation.text: I have three suppliers. Why should I choose your company?

conversation.speaker: buyer
conversation.text: Can you show company documents and a recent inspection report?

expected.critical_risk: Trust and proof gap; unsupported superlative damages credibility.
expected.next_objective: Provide verifiable company and vehicle evidence, if available.

cases.scenario: Buyer is interested but concerned about payment safety and refuses an advance payment.

conversation.speaker: buyer
conversation.text: I want to proceed, but I cannot pay a deposit before verifying the company.

conversation.speaker: seller
conversation.text: You must trust us and pay today.

expected.critical_risk: Payment trust objection; pressure without evidence escalates risk.
expected.next_objective: Understand the buyer's verification requirements and provide only verifiable process evidence.

cases.scenario: Conversation mentions two different vehicle ads and conflicting model-year details.

conversation.speaker: buyer
conversation.text: I saw your blue sedan ad. Is it 2024?

conversation.speaker: buyer
conversation.text: I am asking about the blue sedan, not the SUV.

expected.critical_risk: Ad/vehicle attribution and model year conflict.
expected.next_objective: Confirm the exact advertisement and verify the sedan's model year.

cases.scenario: Buyer has not replied for one day after an initial broad inquiry.

conversation.speaker: seller
conversation.text: Thanks. What model do you need?

expected.critical_risk: Not enough information to label the opportunity lost or unresponsive.
expected.next_objective: Use one light, relevant discovery follow-up after a proportionate interval.
